headings.usage: Use Manrope for all H1-H4 elements. Never use Inter. Keep letter spacing tight (tracking-tight) for large headers to maintain an Apple-grade clean aesthetic.

body.usage: Use Figtree for all body text, chat messages, and UI labels. It offers exceptional legibility and a soft, friendly curve.

colors.rules: The UI must feel like a calming space. Use 'Liquid Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl with highly transparent backgrounds) over any images. Never use solid glaring reds for escalations; use the 'escalation_warm' terracotta to signal importance without panic.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 light, bg-black/60 dark, border-white/20) for sticky headers, floating navs, and proactive check-in overlays.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use capsule geometry (fully rounded pill shapes for buttons, tags, and inputs). Replace hard dividers with subtle blurs or 1px border-black/5 (light) / border-white/5 (dark).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] for standard cards. No harsh drop shadows.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Let the UI breathe. The chat interface should be centrally constrained (max-w-3xl) but with vast negative space around it.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_admin: Use Mode B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Cardless approach for data tables to look strictly functional and clean.
grids_and_layouts.proactive_cards: Use Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8) with wide gaps (gap-8) to display daily check-ins organically rather than rigid lists.

component_usage.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn UI (Input, Form, Checkbox, Select). Customize the border radius to full (capsule) and remove harsh focus rings. Focus states should use a soft primary ring.
component_usage.chat_interface: Custom layout. Avoid standard generic 'chat bubbles'. Use a beautiful staggered layout where user text is right-aligned in a soft capsule, and CampionAI is left-aligned with no bubble, just clean typography and an avatar, providing a manuscript feel.
component_usage.memory_controls: Shadcn Tabs and Dialogs for the 'Memory System'. Ensure the 'Private Mode' toggle is a highly tactile, Apple-style switch component.
component_usage.toasts: Sonner (located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js). Use for 'Memory saved' or 'Check-in scheduled' feedback.

motion.rules: Soft motion only. Entrances should be slight vertical drifts (translateY 10px to 0) with opacity fades. The 'AI generating' state should NOT be a pulsing three-dot loader, but a multi-color shimmer animation (LinearGradient with hue rotation) on a capsule that fades immediately once the text appears.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA or WCAG AA standard (4.5:1).
accessibility.focus: Clear but soft focus rings. No element should lose visibility on hover.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-button', data-testid='private-mode-toggle').

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Images should only be used for the Proactive Check-in cards or Onboarding aesthetic backgrounds.

morning_checkin_bg.description: Warm sunlight casting shadows. Use as an ambient background for the morning check-in flow.

peaceful_memory_state.description: Single tree on a verdant hill. Use in the 'Memory / Profile' empty states to create a calming vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files. Ensure all React components are built as .js files with functional components.
Install required icon libraries: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react (best for the calm, duotone Apple feel).
Do NOT use 'transparent' background on headers or floating navigation. Always apply a backdrop-blur and semi-transparent color (Liquid Glass).
Ensure 'CampionAI' always feels human, calm, and spacious.
Never build generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment and subtle asymmetry for the marketing/onboarding phases.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
